name: excel_mcp
description: High-performance Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheet automation and generation.
long_description: Excel MCP provides token-optimized tools to create, edit, format, inspect, and analyze Excel spreadsheets. Features single-pass workbook building (saving >90% tokens), visual design presets (corporate, financial, modern, compact), lightweight outline inspection, formula automation, and native chart generation.

tools.name: build_workbook
tools.description: Build a complete multi-sheet Excel workbook with design presets, typography, zebra striping, currency/date formats, formulas, and charts in a single pass.

tools.name: build_sheet
tools.description: Construct or populate a full styled worksheet in a single pass with headers, rows, formulas, and styling.

tools.name: get_workbook_outline
tools.description: Extract a lightweight structural outline of workbook sheets, dimensions, headers, and formulas without dumping massive cell grids.

tools.name: batch_write_data
tools.description: Write a 2D matrix of values or formulas into a specified cell range in a single atomic operation.

tools.name: create_excel_workbook
tools.description: Create a new Excel workbook file.

tools.name: create_excel_worksheet
tools.description: Create a new worksheet in an existing Excel workbook.

tools.name: read_data_from_excel
tools.description: Read cell values or tabular data ranges from an Excel worksheet.

tools.name: write_data_to_excel
tools.description: Write data values to specific cells in a worksheet.

tools.name: format_range_excel
tools.description: Apply font, fill, border, alignment, or number format styling to a range.

tools.name: copy_worksheet
tools.description: Duplicate a worksheet within an Excel workbook.

tools.name: delete_worksheet
tools.description: Remove a worksheet from an Excel workbook.

tools.name: rename_worksheet
tools.description: Rename a worksheet in an Excel workbook.

tools.name: get_workbook_metadata
tools.description: Retrieve metadata, sheet names, and properties of an Excel workbook.

tools.name: merge_cells
tools.description: Merge a range of cells into a single cell.

tools.name: unmerge_cells
tools.description: Unmerge a previously merged cell range.

tools.name: copy_range
tools.description: Copy cells, formatting, and formulas from one range to another.

tools.name: delete_range
tools.description: Clear or delete a range of cells and shift adjacent cells.

tools.name: validate_excel_range
tools.description: Validate the syntax and bounds of an Excel cell range.

tools.name: validate_formula_syntax
tools.description: Validate the syntax of an Excel formula string.

tools.name: apply_formula_excel
tools.description: Apply an Excel formula to a cell or cell range.

tools.name: create_chart
tools.description: Generate a chart (bar, line, pie, scatter) from worksheet data.

tools.name: create_pivot_table
tools.description: Create a pivot table summarizing worksheet data.

tools.name: list_excel_documents
tools.description: List available Excel (.xlsx) files within allowed directories.

directory.title: Allowed directories
directory.description: Select directories where this server can read and write Excel files.
